feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 3 June 2026 5:45am
items.description:
##Today##

Outbreaks of rain this morning, turning persistent and quite heavy at times, bringing some hill fog as well. The rain will clear to sunny intervals by late morning as the winds veer southwest, but scattered showers will develop and may become more widespread for a while later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

8-12, risk 18.


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S 15 occasionally 20, soon increasing 20-25, occasionally 30 for time. Veering SW late morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and showers. Hill fog becoming isolated later.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Risk of heavy rain.


##Tomorrow##

Breezy, with occasional showers becoming more frequent at times, but tending to slowly clear from the south during the evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

4-8


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

W or SW 20-25, veering W or WNW 25-30 for a time late Thursday evening and early night.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Hill fog at times.


##Comments##

Strong winds.


##Friday, 5 June 2026##

Sunny spells and only isolated showers during the day. A band of rain arrives overnight into Saturday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 20-25, soon decreasing S or SW 15-20. Backing S or SE later. Occasionally 25 early Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers. Isolated hill fog patches.


##Comments##

Strong wind at first and again later.


##Saturday, 6 June 2026##

Outbreaks of rain for much of the day, persistent at times. Gradually clearing away in the evening and overnight into Sunday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10


##Wind Speed##

24


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

SE 20-25, occasionally 30 for a time, veering W or SW 15-25 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any rain. Hill fog at times.


##Comments##

Strong wind.


##Sunday, 7 June 2026##

Sunny spells and a risk of isolated showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 20-25, decreasing 10-15 later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Comments##

Low confidence for details of rain/showers at this range.
